fn maker():
    state=0
    fn increment[mut state]():
        state+=1
        return state
    return increment
f=maker()
x=f()

state=0
fn increment():
    state+=1
    return state

record R:
    value:int
    fn reader(self):
        return fn()=>self.value

fn outer[T](value:T):
    return fn(other:T)=>other+value
f=outer(1)
x=f(2)
